description: Use for "how does this price compare to history" and "is the market ignoring the base rate". Compares a market price with the historical base rate for a class of events: the gap in pp, a signal, and sample-size quality. Pass a known baseRateId (the parameter lists them) or your own baseRateValue. Free, no key.

baseRateId.description: Known base-rate id to look up (includes sample size + source).

baseRateValue.description: Your own base rate in % (0–100), used when no baseRateId is given.

marketPrice.description: Current market price in cents / implied probability % (0–100). Needed for a real answer. Accepts 55, "55%", "55¢", "$0.55", 0.55 or American odds (+120 / -150) — all read as 55%.

name: base_rate_gap
title: Base Rate Gap
